tasks.title: Academic Discussion
tasks.class: Online Learning- Flexibility or Personal Interaction
tasks.instruction:
Your professor is teaching a class. Write a post responding to the professor's question.
In your response, you should do the following:
• Express and support your personal opinion.
• Make a contribution to the discussion in your own words.
An effective response will contain at least 100 words.

professor.name: Dr. Gupta
professor.text: Today we'll discuss the benefits and drawbacks of online learning. Supporters of online learning believe that it offers flexibility and access to a wide range of courses. Critics, on the other hand, believe that online learning lacks the personal interaction and structure of traditional classrooms. In your opinion, which of these factors do you believe plays a larger role in the effectiveness of online learning? Why?

posts.name: Claire
posts.text: I think the flexibility and access to diverse courses would remove a significant barrier that often prevents students from furthering their education. That barrier is location. Online learning enables potential learners to explore specialized fields and skills that might not otherwise be available where they live.

posts.name: Paul
posts.text: I believe that the lack of personal interaction during online learning sessions can be detrimental to true learning. Traditional classrooms provide direct and immediate support from teachers that students don't receive during online learning classes. A classroom teacher can respond to students and answer questions in real time, which is not always possible when taking online classes.
